# MDV2 — Pull Request

## Authority / scope
- Linked Issue:
- Requirement / SDD / ADR / AC IDs and approved versions:
- Goal and concrete behavior before/after:
- Code / docs / config changes:
- Out of scope:

## Git provenance
- Repository:
- Base branch + full SHA:
- Work branch + pushed head SHA:
- Preserved predecessors / related PRs:
- Relay checkpoint link / status / next agent (when handing over):

## Verification
- Actual commands, toolchain, exit status, CI run links:
- Regression scope and remaining NOT_TESTED cases:
- Screenshots / video / trace / sanitized evidence:
- Security/privacy review (including logs, fixtures and attachments):
- Deployment impact (source → artifact checksum → revision/environment → URL):
- Blockers / open decisions / next owners:

## Review gate
- [ ] All intentional code/document/test/config changes committed and pushed; remote SHA verified.
- [ ] Requirement/SDD and acceptance evidence linked; failures/blocked/not-run cases disclosed.
- [ ] No secrets, private customer sources, commercial documents or real candidate data exposed.
- [ ] Existing website artifacts and unrelated work preserved, or approved change explicitly evidenced.
- [ ] PO approval recorded before merge/release/deployment; Draft does not mean accepted.

Do not close an Issue automatically while acceptance/blockers remain open. Use `Refs #N` until its complete Done gate is satisfied. No agent self-report substitutes for independent review.
